node.statement: Lower norm bootstrap. The definition of a_n and the exact source C*-identity give a_n||X||^2<=||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||. Node 1.3.2.1 and the target product-norm and involution axioms give ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||<=(1+epsilon)||gamma_n(X)||^2+D e||X||^2. Taking the infimum over nonzero X yields (1+epsilon)a_n^2>=a_n-D e. If a_n>=1 there is nothing to prove; if c_0<=a_n<1, then a_n(1-a_n)<=epsilon a_n^2+D e<=(25+D)e, so 1-a_n<=(25+D)e/c_0. Together with node 1.3.2.2, K_boot=max{25+D,(25+D)/c_0} gives 1-K_boot e<=a_n<=b_n<=1+K_boot e, uniformly in n.
